name: print-social-white-grid-card-company-news-carousel-slide
title: Company News Grid-Card Slide
whatItIs: A portrait carousel slide with a stacked white card on faint grid paper: a bold sans 'Company news', three icon-led news lines, and a book cover, badge and flag sticker cluster.
whatItMeans: A clear structure with airy white makes updates friendly and skimmable. The sticker cluster adds personality.
techniques: Stacked paper cards under the main card for depth
Blue rounded icon tiles as bullet markers
Bold key phrases in otherwise light text
Pill footers with page count and navigation arrow
Overlapping stickers and mockups at the card edge
bestFor: Company updates and newsletters on LinkedIn

vocabulary.definition: Layers of offset sheets peeking from under the main card.
An icon in a small tile that replaces a bullet dot.
A '02/06' style pill showing position in the carousel.
